title: History.
description: Develop sophisticated historical analysis through in-depth period studies, interpretations and independent research.

sections.title: Breadth Study
sections.text: Long-term developments across at least 100 years, analysing change and continuity over time.

sections.title: Depth Study
sections.text: Focused investigation of a shorter time period, examining causation, consequence and significance.

sections.title: Historical Interpretations
sections.text: Evaluating different historians’ views, analysing bias and constructing balanced arguments.

sections.title: Source Evaluation
sections.text: Assessing provenance, utility, reliability and contextual knowledge in extended responses.

sections.title: Coursework (NEA)
sections.text: Independent historical investigation (3,000–4,000 words) using primary and secondary sources.

sections.title: Essay Technique
sections.text: Developing substantiated judgement, thematic organisation and precise use of evidence in 20–25 mark essays.
